lines: Mere qaatil, mere dildaar, mere paas raho
couplets.en: My killer, my love, stay close to me.
When the night begins to stir.

lines: Aasmaanon ka lahu pee ke siyaah raat chale
couplets.en: The black night moves, having drunk the blood of the skies.
It carries a balm of musk and a diamond blade.

lines: Bain karti hui, hansti hui, gaati nikle
couplets.en: It comes out wailing, laughing, singing.

lines: Dard ki kaasni paazeb bajaati nikle
couplets.en: It comes out ringing the violet anklet of sorrow.

lines: Jis ghari seenon mein doobe hue dil
couplets.en: When hearts have sunk deep in their chests.

lines: Aasteenon mein nihaan haathon ki raah takne lage
couplets.en: They wait for hands still hidden in sleeves.
They are still holding out hope.

lines: Aur bachchon ke bilakhne ki tarah qulqul-e-mai
couplets.en: And the wine gurgles like a child sobbing.

lines: Bahr-e-naasoodgi machle to manaaye na maane
couplets.en: Restless, it will not be soothed.

lines: Jab koi baat banaaye na bane
couplets.en: When nothing can be set right.
When even words will not come.
When the night begins to stir.

lines: Jis ghari maatami sunsaan siyaah raat chale
couplets.en: When the black and desolate night walks in mourning.

lines: Mere qaatil, mere dildaar, mere paas raho
couplets.en: My killer, my love, stay close to me.
